svg.title: Tool shelf journey: every low-fidelity screen on one canvas, connected by its 19 transitions
svg.desc: The 10 low-fidelity screens, one column per screen of the sitemap. Each line starts at the button or prototype-only link that causes it and carries the same number as on the sitemap.

g.text: The shelf keeper approves every loan.
The drill is not yours yet. We will tell
you when the shelf keeper answers.
Prototype only: no button causes these
The drill is booked for a repair this
The keeper approved. Return it by Saturday
Prototype only: no button causes these
Send report with the box empty
Report the drill broken: say what happened
Say what happened to the drill
Error: Say what happened to the drill
Thanks, the keeper will check it

path.title: 1. shelf to tool: Choose a tool
3. tool to requested: Ask to borrow
4. tool to shelf: Back to the shelf
5. requested to borrowed: The shelf keeper approves
6. requested to declined: The shelf keeper declines
7. requested to tool: Withdraw the request
8. declined to shelf: Back to the shelf
10. my-loans to returned: I have returned it
11. my-loans to report: Report it broken
12. my-loans to shelf: Back to the shelf
13. report to reported: Send report with what happened
14. report to report-error: Send report with the box empty
16. report-error to reported: Say what happened and send
18. reported to shelf: Back to the shelf
19. returned to shelf: Back to the shelf

svg.text: Each line leaves from the control that causes it. The same screens, one per file, are in wireframes/.
